notes: OpenCode 2.x through the service API (#2109 P5b-2). A slow prompt, and a second one queued while it runs (delivery queue). One contiguous working span through the queued prompt's arrival — no ready, no waiting for at least 12s — then ready once everything is consumed. The transcript holds both user rows.

where.text: Now also list three fun facts about giraffes. Do not use any tools.

text: The API session is admitted when its first activity lands (P3, #2107): a ses_… transcript_new. Its first state is not pinned — an API session is first seen working (P4; P5a's smoke cells)
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
The first (slow) prompt drives the session to working
The queued prompt arrives mid-turn: the session holds working — no ready, no waiting — for at least 12s (bounded window), past the queued row's landing
The plugin's Stop hook ends the execution once the queue is drained
The cycle ends at ready once everything is consumed
